syntheticPinkNoise.warning: Not an exact SNR measurement and not a genuine recorded environment.

syntheticTelephonyBand.method: 300-3400 Hz band with 8 kHz roundtrip resampled to 16 kHz

results.interpretation: Most perturbation outputs changed label sequences, so they cannot be compared boundary-by-boundary without a reviewed normalization rule.

limitations: This report is a synthetic robustness probe, not full acoustic calibration.
No real phone, laptop, headset, microphone-distance, clipping, echo, or low-SNR matrix was captured.
No numeric acceptance thresholds were pre-approved.
Independent speech/acoustic or qualified Korean SME review is required.
